entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. To better direct your call, please say 'Sales' or 'Customer Support'.
Customer Support!
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return my VeloBand Pulse. It's just not accurate at all. I want to send it back.
I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with the VeloBand Pulse. I can certainly look into that return for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yeah, hold on... It's VF9876543.
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see your order. It looks like it was delivered about 15 days ago.
Yeah, and? I just got around to trying it out properly this weekend. It's junk. So, can you send me the return label or what?
Well, sir, I see the issue here. Our return policy is for 14 days from the date of delivery. It looks like you're just one day outside that window, so the system won't let me start a return.
Are you serious? One day? You're going to deny my return over one single day? I've been busy! This is ridiculous.
I do understand your frustration, sir, but the policy is automated in our system...
I don't want to hear about your system! I want to return a product that I'm not happy with. This is terrible customer service.
Okay... look. Let's just... let's get this sorted out. Technically, I'm not supposed to do this, and honestly, my **manager would kill me** if she saw this.
Saw what? You helping a customer?
I'm going to make a **one-time exception** for you. I'll have to manually **override the system** to get this approved. It might take me a moment.
Wait, really? You can do that?

I can. Just please hold on... Okay, I've pushed it through. You should receive an email with a prepaid return shipping label in the next five to ten minutes. Just print that out, attach it to the box, and drop it off.
Wow. Okay. Thank you. I really appreciate you doing that. I was about to lose my mind.
It's no problem at all. We want to make sure you're taken care of. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. Seriously, thank you, Sarah. You've been a huge help.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
